description.text: The School of Law offers courses to law majors and sees to the ideological and political education to students of the whole university. Among the 60 teachers of the school, there are 20 professors and associate professors, 13 PhDs; besides, most of the full-time teachers are MA degrees holders. In recent years, the school has published around 300 theses in various journals, 40 treatises, and participated in more than 10 research projects above provincial level have been. B.A. Law Objectives: This program aims to qualify students as senior experts systemically master legal knowledge, Chinese law and related policies. Objects: Four- year Bachelor of Law Degree Main courses: Jurisprudence, History of Chinese legal systems, Constitution, Administrative Law and Administrative Procedure Law, Civil Law, Commercial Law, Economic Law, Criminal Law, Criminal Procedure Law, Labor Law, Environmental Law, Civil Procedure Law, International Law, International Private Law and International Economic Law.

duration.text: The Law at Nanjing Audit University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 5 or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school

requirements.text: 1. HSK level 3 or above 2. High school graduate
